test_title: PYST 66: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six students - P, Q, R, S T and U - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Q is sitting second to the left of U.

T is sitting third to the right of P.

P is the immediate neighbour of Q and U.

S is not the neighbour of U.

Who among the following is the neighbour of both U and T?
solution:
**Given:** Six students - P, Q, R, S T and U - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

1) Q is sitting second to the left of U.

2) P is the immediate neighbour of Q and U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6624efd4b6c9d582bc320fa1b443635ad1dc56f29d75f18e95a36072050adb42.png] 

3) T is sitting third to the right of P.

4) S is not the neighbour of U.

After positioning S only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8766b5235b542fef28d6174b5ee397164e8be9ede098ec9644060f36ecc27e6.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement R is the neighbour of both U and T.

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the correct answer.
